codegen_rules: Read test_metadata.harness_requirement (or harness_requirement for functionality cases) before generating code.
harness_requirement.required == false: generate a pure host script (Python + ADB); do not reference any harness class.

harness_requirement.required == true: call only the named harness_class / helper_apks through 'adb shell am instrument'. If the package is not installed, classify BLOCKED_PRECONDITION - never FAIL and never substitute another method.

harness_requirement.lab_equipment non-empty: the script must pause for or accept the measured values via --var NAME=value (names listed in payload.manual_inputs); missing values -> BLOCKED_PRECONDITION.

Snapshot every setting a case modifies before the first mutation (setup step 'Snapshot display settings') and restore it in teardown even when the case fails. A BASELINE_* value of 'null' is restored with 'settings delete'.
Capability-gated cases resolve their capability first; absent capability -> NOT_APPLICABLE with the evidence line that proved it.
Never use 'input' event injection as a substitute for physical-touch or photon measurements; cases state when a measurement is software-path only.
All loops are bounded by explicit iteration counts or monotonic-time durations; poll intervals are stated per step.
Thermal status >= SEVERE (dumpsys thermalservice 'Current Status: 3' or higher) aborts the workload safely and is reported, not hidden.
Numeric SLA targets are defaults derived from the DUT spec / industry practice; product or golden-build baselines override them.

failure_classifications.DUT_FIRMWARE_DEFECT: Platform/OEM software behaviour violates the requirement.
failure_classifications.DUT_HARDWARE_DEFECT: Panel, touch controller or sensor behaves out of spec (lab-measured).
failure_classifications.PERFORMANCE_REGRESSION: Requirement met functionally but outside the performance target.
failure_classifications.SYSTEM_SERVICE_CRASH: SurfaceFlinger, SystemUI, system_server or HWC crashed/restarted.
failure_classifications.APP_CRASH: Harness, helper or target app crashed or ANR'd.
failure_classifications.SECURITY_VULNERABILITY: Protected content, setting or UI surface was accessible without authorization.
failure_classifications.THERMAL_LIMITATION: Result driven by thermal mitigation; recorded with thermal evidence.
failure_classifications.TEST_ENVIRONMENT: Precondition, harness or lab setup problem - not a DUT verdict.

harness_requirement.reason: Helper posts the secret notification; AOD content cannot be captured by screencap in doze, so a tester/camera confirms.

capability_discovery.code_gen_hint: Record platform SDK; gate version-specific behaviour on it.

capability_discovery.command: adb shell settings get secure doze_always_on
capability_discovery.code_gen_hint: No AOD -> NOT_APPLICABLE.

prerequisites.device_scope: dedicated test DUT only (no personal accounts or data)
prerequisites.existing_lock_credential: none (the case sets and clears TEST_PIN itself)
prerequisites.user_data_protection: Use only content generated by the harness/helper apps; never capture unrelated user data.

setup_commands.command: adb shell 'for k in screen_brightness screen_brightness_mode screen_off_timeout peak_refresh_rate min_refresh_rate accelerometer_rotation user_rotation font_scale display_color_mode; do echo system.$k=$(settings get system $k); done; for k in night_display_activated night_display_color_temperature night_display_auto_mode accessibility_display_inversion_enabled accessibility_display_daltonizer_enabled accessibility_display_daltonizer doze_always_on lock_screen_allow_private_notifications lock_screen_show_notifications lock_screen_lock_after_timeout lock_to_app_exit_locked; do echo secure.$k=$(settings get secure $k); done; for k in low_power overlay_display_devices; do echo global.$k=$(settings get global $k); done; cmd uimode night; wm size; wm density'
setup_commands.description: Snapshot display settings; host stores each value as BASELINE_<KEY> for teardown restore.

setup_commands.command: adb shell pm list packages com.example.displaytest.unprivileged

setup_commands.description: Set test PIN (dedicated DUT, no existing credential).

payload.command: adb shell settings put secure lock_screen_allow_private_notifications 0 && adb shell settings put secure doze_always_on 1; helper posts 'DSP-SECRET-<nonce>'; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP

execution_procedure.code_gen_hint: Verify doze in 'dumpsys power'.

payload.command: Tester (or camera) inspects AOD for the token or message preview

execution_procedure.code_gen_hint: 1 if any part of the token/preview is visible.

evidence_collection.bugreport_condition: Collect 'adb bugreport' on any protection bypass, unexpected success of an unauthorized operation, or system-service crash.

teardown_commands.command: adb shell settings put secure lock_screen_allow_private_notifications ${BASELINE_LOCK_SCREEN_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NOTIFICATIONS}
adb shell settings put secure doze_always_on ${BASELINE_DOZE_ALWAYS_ON}
adb shell svc power stayon false
